name: Tomorrow
source:
Aurora, a consumptive woman that has lost all hope of surviving the disease. Alvin, a grief-stricken husband that is helpless over the cruel fate of his wife. Aldous, a calculating, inflexible man with shadowy intentions. These are the actors of this little tale, a tragedy in three acts.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221103073004/http://renai.us/game/tomorrow.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
奥萝拉是一名罹患肺病、已经对康复不抱希望的女性。阿尔文是她悲痛欲绝的丈夫，面对妻子的残酷命运无能为力。奥尔德斯则是精于算计、冷酷固执且意图不明的男子。他们是这则小故事的演员，共同演绎一出三幕悲剧。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221103073004/http://renai.us/game/tomorrow.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
